content:
Aisha (People Ops): Hey team — planning to start an 8-week parental leave on Mon May 5. I'm also doing an international relocation right before that; quick q: what paperwork and timing do I need so payroll/benefits top-up and tax withholding don't get messed up? Also need to arrange handoffs for my on-call week.

People Ops Bot: Please submit a leave request here: https://hr.redwood.com/leave — upload supporting docs to the portal. Required: birth/adoption paperwork, FMLA (if eligible), and passport/visa if relocating. See FAQ: https://hr.redwood.com/faq/leave :memo:

Aisha (People Ops): Thanks — how soon does payroll need the docs for the top-up to start in the same payroll period?

HR Benefits: For top-up to apply on your first paid period, we need docs at least 10 business days before your first unpaid day to allow payroll runs to process. If your relocation changes your tax residency or withholding, please cc benefits@redwood.com and finance-relocation@redwood.com.

Diego (Eng Manager): @Aisha I can cover the on-call week (May 3–9) and run job-shadow sessions before you go. Can you drop a 1-pager of critical duties and any runbook links? :+1:

Sam K: Quick ops Q — laptop/equipment while you're abroad? Do you want to ship your machine or get a temporary loaner? IT can do either. Ping it-support@redwood.com.

Aisha (People Ops): I'll put together the 1-pager today. Also: I'd like to keep one lightweight check-in per week while away (1 hour, async-first). Is partial availability allowed?

People Ops Bot: Partial/limited check-ins are allowed with manager sign-off. When you submit the leave request, set availability to 'Limited — timezone constrained' and note preferred check-in window.

Aisha (People Ops): Uploading a quick checklist here for visibility:

```
- Submit leave request: https://hr.redwood.com/leave
- Upload docs: birth/adoption, passport/visa, FMLA forms
- Confirm payroll top-up: benefits@redwood.com (>=10 business days before)
- Notify finance if relocating: finance-relocation@redwood.com
- Schedule job-shadow for critical flows: Diego
- Set calendar OOO + emergency contact
- Arrange laptop handoff or temporary machine via IT: it-support@redwood.com
```

Diego (Eng Manager): Looks good. Please ping me the draft 1-pager by EOD and I'll block time for shadowing.

HR Benefits: Also note: international relocation can affect benefits eligibility windows (medical coverage start/end). We'll give you a short checklist after you submit the docs. Email benefits@redwood.com if anything is time-sensitive.

Aisha (People Ops): Awesome, appreciate the help everyone :rocket: — I'll submit the form and loop back with the 1-pager by lunchtime.
